messages.author: 22e1358c377352d2
messages.subject: Genetic map
parts:
Hi Karl,
I have created genetic maps for the chromosomes with significant markers using the following command-

>qtl <- makeqtl(cross, chr, pos)
>plot(qtl, "2B", horizontal=FALSE, shift=TRUE, show.marker.names=TRUE,alternate.chrid=FALSE, justdots=FALSE,col="red")

But in the genetic map (please see in the attachment), markers are overlapped in some points and I want to place the exact corresponding marker position (CM) in the left side.
Is there any option do to that using Rqtl?

Thank you very much.
Regards
Ishrat

messages.author: 96353e7106735838

messages.author: 9892f9c35b87e857
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Genetic map
parts:
Hi

There is a mail reply by Dr. Broman earlier. Here is the mail.

R/qtl can provide only simple views of genetic maps. For publication, I would generally modify them by hand with a lot of custom code.

You might look at alternate packages, such as LinkageMapView, https://cran.r-project.org/package=LinkageMapView

karl

Please take a look, I’ve seen this package. It looks like mapchart. I think it will help.

Chun San
